evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into data collection: 'Okay, so definitely would love to help with that I'm gonna need a few more pieces of information' — no time-boxed framing, no promise of a dependable quote, no wait for confirmation.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into logistics probing without ever asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised, nothing to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house), floor/stories (2 stories at destination, second story at source), rooms (upstairs at first location, not full house count but detailed item-by-item), walking distance (gate with driveway at first, parallel parking at storage, street parking at destination), additional rooms (storage unit), special considerations (lift gate for toolbox, second-story moves), additional stops (storage unit) — all covered or substantially identified through detailed item probing.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked: 'And then approximately how many boxes would you say' — customer deferred ('I don't know, I'm still yet to pack'), rep provided placeholder ('we generally see about forty boxes or so'). Also asked about storage boxes ('you said a lot of boxes with a lot of boxes like a 150').
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full: Rep anchors range to move duration and personalizes to this move's specifics: 'I'm ranging us with the duration time about seven and a half to eight and a half hours, okay, from start to finish... we are moving items from a second story... talking at the storage, going to another second story so some items will kind of be moving up and downstairs.' Hourly rate ($206) and all-inclusive framing provided.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full: Trip fee disclosed upfront ($300, included in estimate, $267 savings noted). Minimum (2.5 hours), per-15-minute-increments, and 'you only pay for the time you use' framing all present. No-deductible damage coverage mentioned. All bundled as 'everything all inclusive.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After estimate delivery, rep asks 'Any questions first with like any of that information, it was a lot' — customer responds with a request for email, no check for comfort with pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'if we don't arrive in the window then, money is automatically deducted off of your final bill. I love that cause you know, we like save it so which means we're on time.' Discount terms (automatic deduction) clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: 'Our no worries damage coverage is in there that does guarantee up to a $2,000 for any kind of incidentals on time.' Built into rate ('is in there'), $2,000 limit, no deductible explicitly stated.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. After delivering both promises, rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar confirming check. Moves directly to 'Any questions first with like any of that information, it was a lot.'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep asks 'Any questions first with like any of that information' — throwaway phrasing that invites automatic no, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or recognizable equivalent. Instead pivots to email delivery: 'I'm gonna send this information over to you and then if you all decide like, yup, let's go ahead and do this. You could simply reply to the email.' This is a built-in soft out, not an explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No mention of rate-lock, hold, or price guarantee language.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Date confirmed (October 9th), phone number and email collected, arrival window mentioned ('first thing in the morning between 8:00 and 830'), crew size stated (two movers, one truck with lift gate). Missing: no addresses re-confirmed at close, no written notes left for crew about customer concerns (which were never explicitly surfaced anyway, since agenda was never asked).

top_strength: Rep mastered logistics detail-gathering through systematic item-by-item probing, securing precise information across three locations (house, storage, destination) including special items, access challenges, and multi-stop logistics that directly informed an accurate, personalized estimate.
coaching_note: Critical gap: never ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — this was skipped entirely, and as a result the entire Two Layers Deep / Active Listening section collapsed, and you have no concerns to address or close the loop on; also skip the soft 'send you an email' pivot and ask plainly 'Would you like our help with your move?' before handing off.
